viewing_check: Look for a maker label or stamp (Coogans, Clifton, Lifestyle Furniture), whether it is solid timber or veneer, back boards and drawer construction (dovetails vs machine joints), any key, and wear or sun fade on the top. Photograph the underside of a drawer and the back.
